caseStudies.title: Nexus AI Platform
caseStudies.description: Enterprise-grade AI orchestration platform serving 10M+ daily predictions
caseStudies.longDescription: Nexus needed to unify their fragmented ML infrastructure into a single, scalable platform capable of handling millions of predictions per day while maintaining sub-100ms latency.
caseStudies.challenge: Nexus was running 15 different ML models across fragmented infrastructure, leading to inconsistent results, high latency, and spiraling cloud costs. Their data science team spent 70% of their time on DevOps instead of model development.
caseStudies.solution: We built a unified AI orchestration platform with automated model versioning, A/B testing, and intelligent load balancing. The system auto-scales based on prediction demand and includes a self-service portal for data scientists.

slides.title: Discovery & Architecture
slides.description: We audited 15 existing ML pipelines and designed a unified architecture using Kubernetes for orchestration and TensorFlow Serving for inference.

slides.title: Platform Design
slides.description: Created an intuitive dashboard for data scientists to deploy, monitor, and A/B test models without DevOps involvement.

slides.title: Core Development
slides.description: Built the inference engine with auto-scaling, model versioning, and intelligent routing. Implemented feature stores for real-time feature computation.

slides.title: Production & Scale
slides.description: Deployed to production handling 10M+ daily predictions with 99.99% uptime. Achieved 45ms p99 latency across all model types.

testimonial.quote: WYDGT transformed our ML infrastructure from a liability into a competitive advantage. Our data scientists now ship models 10x faster.
testimonial.author: Dr. Sarah Chen

caseStudies.title: Velocity FinTech
caseStudies.description: Real-time payment processing system handling $2B+ monthly transactions
caseStudies.longDescription: Velocity needed to replace their legacy payment system with a modern, real-time platform capable of processing billions in monthly volume while meeting strict regulatory requirements.
caseStudies.challenge: Velocity's legacy COBOL-based system couldn't handle peak loads, with transaction failures climbing to 5% during high-traffic periods. Regulatory audits were becoming increasingly difficult.
caseStudies.solution: We designed a distributed, event-sourced payment engine in Go with real-time fraud detection. The system includes comprehensive audit logging and automated compliance reporting.

slides.title: System Analysis
slides.description: Mapped the entire legacy system, identified bottlenecks, and designed a migration path that ensured zero downtime during the transition.

slides.title: Interface Design
slides.description: Designed real-time dashboards for operations teams showing transaction flows, fraud alerts, and compliance status.

slides.title: Engine Development
slides.description: Built the payment engine using Go for performance, PostgreSQL for ACID compliance, and Redis for sub-millisecond caching.

slides.title: Launch & Validation
slides.description: Successfully migrated 100% of traffic with zero data loss. System now handles 3x previous peak loads with 99.999% uptime.

testimonial.quote: The new system handles Black Friday traffic like any other day. We haven't had a single transaction failure in 6 months.
testimonial.author: Michael Torres

caseStudies.title: HealthBridge
caseStudies.description: HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform connecting 50K+ patients monthly
caseStudies.longDescription: HealthBridge needed a secure, scalable telemedicine platform that could handle video consultations, e-prescriptions, and EHR integration while maintaining strict HIPAA compliance.
caseStudies.challenge: HealthBridge was losing patients to competitors with better digital experiences. Their existing portal was web-only, slow, and required multiple apps for different functions.
caseStudies.solution: We built a unified mobile-first platform with seamless video calls, in-app prescriptions, and deep EHR integration. The app works offline and syncs when connectivity returns.

slides.title: User Research
slides.description: Conducted interviews with 50+ patients and 20 providers to understand pain points and design a unified care journey.

slides.title: Experience Design
slides.description: Created a calming, accessible interface that works for all ages while meeting ADA and HIPAA requirements.

slides.title: Platform Build
slides.description: Developed cross-platform mobile apps with React Native, WebRTC for video, and end-to-end encryption for all data.

slides.title: National Rollout
slides.description: Launched across 500+ clinics with 94% provider adoption. Patient wait times dropped from 15 minutes to under 2.

testimonial.quote: Our patients love the new app. We've seen a 40% increase in appointment completion rates since launch.
testimonial.author: Dr. Emily Watson

caseStudies.title: Quantum Commerce
caseStudies.description: Headless commerce platform powering 500+ global storefronts
caseStudies.longDescription: Quantum needed to modernize their monolithic e-commerce platform into a headless architecture that could power diverse storefronts globally.
caseStudies.challenge: Quantum's monolithic platform couldn't support their expansion into new markets. Each new storefront required months of custom development and created maintenance nightmares.
caseStudies.solution: We architected a headless commerce platform with a unified GraphQL API, allowing teams to spin up new storefronts in days with any frontend technology.

slides.title: Platform Strategy
slides.description: Defined the headless architecture, API contracts, and migration strategy for 500+ existing storefronts.

slides.title: Design System
slides.description: Created a flexible design system with 50+ components that could be customized per brand while maintaining consistency.

slides.title: API Development
slides.description: Built the GraphQL commerce API with real-time inventory, dynamic pricing, and multi-currency support.

slides.title: Global Rollout
slides.description: Migrated all storefronts to the new platform. New market launches now take days instead of months.

caseStudies.title: Aether Protocol
caseStudies.longDescription: Aether needed a Layer 2 solution that could dramatically reduce gas costs while maintaining the security guarantees of Ethereum mainnet.
caseStudies.challenge: Ethereum mainnet gas costs were making Aether's DeFi protocol unusable for most users. Transactions that should cost cents were costing $50+.
caseStudies.solution: We built a ZK-rollup Layer 2 with validity proofs, enabling near-instant transactions at 95% lower cost while inheriting Ethereum's security.

slides.title: Protocol Design
slides.description: Designed the ZK-rollup architecture with optimal batch sizes and proof generation strategies.

slides.title: Developer UX
slides.description: Created SDKs and documentation that made deploying to L2 as easy as deploying to mainnet.

slides.title: Core Protocol
slides.description: Implemented the prover in Rust, smart contracts in Solidity, and built the sequencer infrastructure.

slides.title: Mainnet Launch
slides.description: Launched to mainnet with $500M+ TVL migrated in the first month. Processing 100K+ TPS at peak.

caseStudies.title: Nova Analytics
caseStudies.description: Real-time business intelligence dashboard for Fortune 500
caseStudies.longDescription: Nova needed to consolidate data from 20+ sources into a real-time analytics platform that could surface insights automatically.
caseStudies.challenge: Nova's analysts spent 80% of their time gathering data from siloed systems. Reports took weeks to generate and were often outdated by the time they reached executives.
caseStudies.solution: We built a unified data platform with real-time ingestion, automated anomaly detection, and natural language querying for non-technical users.

slides.title: Data Audit
slides.description: Cataloged 20+ data sources, defined a unified schema, and designed real-time ingestion pipelines.

slides.title: Dashboard Design
slides.description: Created role-based dashboards with drill-down capabilities and automated insight surfacing.

slides.title: Platform Build
slides.description: Built the data platform on Snowflake with Spark for processing and a React frontend for visualization.

slides.title: Enterprise Rollout
slides.description: Rolled out to 5,000+ users across 12 countries. Analysts now spend 80% of time on insights, not data gathering.
